campaign.checks: Native keyboard loop/ramp/shaft flight, real relays/doors, extraction and replay. Existing labeled development neutralize action isolates these route checks from combat; ordinary-fire combat/victory/death and mixer/settings cases are included in the full suite.

visualReview.findings: Default editor has no scene/build sidebar; name/save strip and selection inspector stay visible. New mission cards lead the library, with practice collapsed. External ship, HUD, forward aiming marker and shortcut status are readable.

milestones.m4: Owner accepted functional editor/playthrough workflow before this UX pass

limits: Functional software-rendered verification. New encounter balance, music taste and final presentation need player review; no new hardware capture, dependency audit, commit, push or deployment. Existing chunk warning remains.
